name: Monsterbane Blade
description: (Tag:blade)(Tag:martial)(Tag:weapon)A hunter's greatsword etched with a hundred monster names. It bites deep into anything bestial, monstrous, or unnatural, through claw, fang, and hide tougher than plate, and takes a trickle of the kill to keep its edge. People die to it like any sword; monsters die to it quickly.
